signature.name: VTask.comp
signature.type: {M : Type u_4} -> {N : Type u_5} -> {P : Type u_6} -> [Mul M] -> [Mul N] -> [Mul P] -> (hnp : N →ₙ* P) -> (hmn : M →ₙ* N) -> M →ₙ* P

conventions.statement: The first argument `hnp` is the outer (second-applied) map and the second argument `hmn` is the inner (first-applied) map, matching standard mathematical composition notation `hnp ∘ hmn`.
conventions.note: Mirrors the convention in Function.comp where the left argument is applied second.

facts.statement: ∀ (M N P : Type*) [Mul M] [Mul N] [Mul P] (hnp : N →ₙ* P) (hmn : M →ₙ* N) (x y : M), VTask.comp hnp hmn (x * y) = VTask.comp hnp hmn x * VTask.comp hnp hmn y

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (M N P : Type*) [Mul M] [Mul N] [Mul P] (hnp : N →ₙ* P) (hmn : M →ₙ* N), Function.Injective hmn → Function.Injective hnp → Function.Injective (VTask.comp hnp hmn)
